2609.16322.title: Cross-Anatomy Transfer Versus Sparse Interpolation in Digital-Twin-Oriented Aortic Fluid-Structure Interaction Surrogates
2609.16322.paper_summary: Surrogate credibility for fluid-structure interac- tion (FSI) requires distinguishing transfer across independent anatomies from interpolation within an already sampled surface. Four de-identified human aortic models from the Vascular Model Repository were reconstructed into separate lumen and nominal 1.5-mm wall domains and analyzed under matched first-cycle two-way FSI. A geometry-only LightGBM prior, selected by leave-one-anatomy-out development on three anatomies, was zero-shot evaluated on a fourth, then probed with a post-zero- shot sparse field-completion case study over six targets. Zero-shot transfer was poor across all targets. At a five-percent anchor level (203 anchors, 3,852 evaluation nodes), prior-plus-adaptation reached an oscillatory shear index (OSI) R2 of 0.603. However, same-anchor controls tuned only on the three development anatomies were stronger for several outcomes: inverse-distance weighting reached R2 = 0.829 (OSI), 0.617 (peak von Mises stress), 0.676 (mean stress); radial basis function interpolation reached 0.917, 0.714, 0.778. Sparse within-anatomy labels thus support field completion, but this four-anatomy cohort gives no evidence the cross-anatomy prior adds value beyond direct interpolation. We frame this as a first computational stage toward a measurement-linked digital twin: the surrogate/update layer is evaluated here, while larger cohorts, converged FSI, measurable patient-side inputs, and physics-informed learning remain future work, not a claim of a complete clinical twin. Our code, data and computation files are available at https://github. com/ali-nourbakhsh2005/Aortic-FSI-Sparse-Field-Completion
2609.16322.paper_summary_zh: 替代可信度對於流體-結構互動（FSI）要求區分跨獨立解剖結構的轉移與在已經取樣的表面內插值。來自血管模型庫的四個去識別化人類主動脈模型被重建為獨立的腔體和名義上的1.5毫米壁域，並在匹配的首次循環雙向FSI下進行分析。通過在三個解剖結構上進行留一解剖結構的開發，選擇了一個僅幾何的LightGBM先驗，並在第四個解剖結構上進行了零-shot評估，隨後在六個目標上進行了一個後零-shot稀疏場補全案例研究。所有目標的零-shot轉移效果都很差。在五百分之一的錨定水平（203個錨點，3,852個評估節點）下，先驗加適應達到了振盪剪切指數（OSI）R2為0.603。然而，僅在三個開發解剖結構上調整的相同錨定控制在幾個結果上表現更強：逆距離加權達到R2 = 0.829（OSI），0.617（峰值von Mises應力），0.676（平均應力）；徑向基函數插值達到0.917，0.714，0.778。因此，稀疏的解剖內標籤支持場補全，但這四個解剖結構的隊列並未提供證據表明跨解剖結構的先驗在直接插值之外增加了價值。我們將此框架視為朝向與測量相關的數位雙胞胎的第一個計算階段：這裡評估了替代/更新層，而更大的隊列、收斂的FSI、可測量的患者側輸入和物理知識學習仍然是未來的工作，而不是完整臨床雙胞胎的聲明。我們的代碼、數據和計算文件可在https://github.com/ali-nourbakhsh2005/Aortic-FSI-Sparse-Field-Completion獲得。
